name: Cankerworm
overview: The cankerworm is depicted in Scripture as a destructive agent sent by God as a form of judgment, consuming what remains after other pests have ravaged the land, as seen in Joel 1:4. This imagery emphasizes the thoroughness of divine discipline, with the cankerworm among the 'great army' of pests God sends to bring correction, yet He also promises restoration from their devastation (Joel 2:25). Nahum further portrays the cankerworm as a consuming force that devours and spreads swiftly, symbolizing the certainty and severity of God's judgment against sin (Nahum 3:15-16).
